claims.content: To open a reversible-lane entrance as part of an opening sequence aimed at achieving the goal state Open North Bound or Open South Bound.

goal.raw_text: To open a reversible-lane entrance as part of an opening sequence aimed at achieving the goal state Open North Bound or Open South Bound.

claims.content: Operator
Normal Operations are in effect and the Operator is logged on.
The Operator initiates an opening sequence to open a reversible-lane entrance.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator initiates an opening sequence to open a reversible-lane entrance.

claims.content: Open Wrong Way Transverse Pop-ups; if more than one bank, open the banks in the direction from the freeway toward the reversible lanes.
Open Wrong Way Longitudinal Pop-ups; open pop-up banks beginning at the entrance ramp nose at the reversible lanes, and proceeding toward the edge of shoulder.
Open Entrance Transverse Pop-ups; if more than one bank, open the banks in the direction from the reversible lanes toward the freeway.
Open Entrance Longitudinal Pop-ups; open pop-up banks downstream (entrance ramp nose at the freeway) to upstream (edge of shoulder).

Change CMS messages from a ‘Closed’ message to an ‘Open’ message beginning with the furthest downstream sign (sign closest to the reversible lane), and proceeding upstream (away from the reversible lanes) as message change confirmations are received from each sign.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to ‘unknown or ‘open’.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device, which was previously opened at the current entrance, changes to ‘unknown’ or ‘closed’.
If multiple entrances exist on the reversible lanes in the direction of travel being opened, the specific order in which those entrances are opened presents no ‘wrong way’ safety issues.

At any point in an opening sequence, if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step, halt the opening sequence. Exit: opening sequence halted.
At any point in an opening sequence, if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open', halt the opening sequence. Exit: opening sequence halted.

At any point in an opening sequence, if the status of a closure device that was previously opened at the current entrance changes to 'unknown' or 'closed', halt the opening sequence. Exit: opening sequence halted.

If the TMC workstations or network server fails, resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North; the Operator shall be able to dial in from a back up computer to either FCU North or FCU South and open and close the reversible lanes. Exit: alternate control at FCU South or FCU North.

If FCU North or South fails (FCU Controller failures or FCU-TSU communications failure), loss of changeable messages signs and DCUs associated with the failed FCU occurs; alternate control is at the non-failed FCU (North or South). Exit: alternate control at the non-failed FCU.

If FCUs North and South both fail (FCU Controller failures or FCUs-TSU and FCU-FCU communications failure), loss of changeable message signs 1-12 and DCUs 1-5 occurs; alternate control units are direct control at DCUs 1-5. Exit: direct control at DCUs 1-5.

If safety screening of a proposed command, including any subordinate commands, would result in an unacceptable reversible lanes configuration, the screening check is considered to have failed. Exit: screening check failed.
Wrong Way Transverse Pop-ups are opened; if more than one bank, the banks are opened in the direction from the freeway toward the reversible lanes.
Wrong Way Longitudinal Pop-ups are opened; pop-up banks are opened beginning at the entrance ramp nose at the reversible lanes, and proceeding toward the edge of shoulder.
Entrance Transverse Pop-ups are opened; if more than one bank, the banks are opened in the direction from the reversible lanes toward the freeway.
Entrance Longitudinal Pop-ups are opened; pop-up banks are opened downstream (entrance ramp nose at the freeway) to upstream (edge of shoulder).

CMS messages are changed from a ‘Closed’ message to an ‘Open’ message beginning with the furthest downstream sign (sign closest to the reversible lane), and proceeding upstream (away from the reversible lanes) as message change confirmations are received from each sign.
